statement: Nvidia publicly denied having any China-specific language processing unit in its roadmap or any LPU sales in China.
why: Whether Nvidia has a compliant China-specific product line determines how much of its data-center demand can be recovered under export controls.

impact.mechanism: A denied China-specific accelerator roadmap keeps controlled-market demand out of Nvidia's addressable base and leaves Chinese buyers with domestic alternatives.

evidence.excerpt: We have no LPU sales in the China market today, and no China-specific LPU product in our roadmap.
CEO Jensen Huang had previously stated in May [2026] that Nvidia had 'largely conceded' China's AI chip market to rival Huawei Technologies.

confidence.basis: Company statement relayed by a single secondary wire story; no filing and no independent second publisher in this document.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: statement/trend changed (trend unknown -> unknown); sources: NVIDIA Newsroom (official press release), Yahoo Finance (Reuters wire story)
